model_specific_risks.risk: Cub Cadet RZT SX EFI zero-turn recall (Oct 24, 2018): the fuel tank neck can crack and leak, a fire hazard. Models 17AWCBYS010, 17AWCBYZ010, 17RWCBYN010, 17RWCBYN210, 17RWCBYS010, 17RWCBYZ010, built Dec 2017 to Jun 2018, about 4,900 sold in the U.S., 15 cracked-neck reports. The remedy is a free repair at an authorized Cub Cadet dealer; whether it was done on this unit is UNKNOWN, and a dealer can answer it from the model and serial. (Model taken from the listing text; not verified against the unit.)
model_specific_risks.source: CPSC: Cub Cadet Recalls Zero-Turn Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert), recall date Oct 24, 2018 <https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2019/Cub-Cadet-Recalls-ZeroTurn-Riding-Mowers-Due-to-Fire-Hazard-Recall-Alert> (retrieved 2026-10-07)

plan.value: Budget about $80 in parts and $10 in materials plus about 3 h of your time (a category estimate; the fault is not diagnosed yet). Even with no parts spend this fails your $500 worst-case loss limit and your $500 per-deal cash limit (it ties up $2,497). The trailer run is already costed in ($27 and 1 h). Sell target is $3,500, the median of 5 sold comparables. Do not budget fuel tank parts until a Cub Cadet dealer confirms whether the free recall repair is still open on this unit.

title: 2018 Cub Cadet RZT SX 54 EFI zero turn mower 17AWCBYS010, tank neck leaking
